name: Luster Industries Bhd
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及常规企业事项，未披露各业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收6371.1万令吉，同比增4.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly quarterly results, general meetings and routine corporate matters, with no disclosure of expansion, reduction, disposal or new contracts for any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 63.711 million, up 4.4% year-on-year.
